title: Mors Drink Order
description: Mors Drink Order — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Khodebshchik

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to side areas off Levels 5 and 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Kill Volcanic Gushers for 15 Fire Eyes. Kill Shadowspawn Knights or Dark Angels for 15 bags of Shadow Spice. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Khodebshchik

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Mors Drink Delivery

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to side areas off Levels 5 and 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Kill Volcanic Gushers for 15 Fire Eyes. Kill Shadowspawn Knights or Dark Angels for 15 bags of Shadow Spice. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Offer:

I wonder if I should get some sort of bless or divine spell put onto my hands. You think I would get a 'plus one' to my skill in drink making if I did?

Anyhoo, my spicy sense is tingling and telling me the next bits that I need are 'Fire Eyes,' which can be found on Volcanic Gushers in the lower-level side areas of Ratsputin's Gulag. My senses say we need fifteen Fire Eyes!

Now for something to calm the fire in the drink, like my hands on your face. A cinnamon-like spice. Like the smell trailing Shadowspawn Knights and Dark Angels as they float by? Find these Shadow Knights and Dark Angels to crack them open and find this spice substance. You'll find them in the side areas of Lower Ratsputin's Gulag and collect fifteen bags full of whatever that smell is originating from.

Once you have collected them, return to your Master Khodebshchik here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Thank you again for all your help. Perhaps, one day I can open up shop and you can be my apprentice? Perhaps you should start applying now, for I know soon there will be a very long line forming. Before I continue to get lost in my fantastic mind, I must remind you, my loyal subject: I will be needing your services later. Look to me soon for a sign that I am in need of you.

Objectives:

  • Fire Eyes ×15
  • Shadow Spice ×15

Client level range: 75–100
